messages:
mira: hey team, started today! accepted the org invite but when i try to push my feature branch `git push origin mira/feat/cli` i get 403: remote: You do not have permission to push to this repository. any tips on who to loop in?

onboard-bot: Welcome Mira! If you were invited with SSO enabled, make sure you clicked 'Authorize' in the GitHub SSO modal. See onboarding doc: https://handbook.redwood.com/onboarding/github

mira: i clicked accept and the banner said i'm a member. i can view repos in the web ui but pushing errors out.

ops-jordan: likely a repo-level team mapping issue. can you paste `git remote -v` and confirm which GitHub username you're using? also, are you pushing to origin upstream or to your fork?

mira: `git remote -v` shows `origin	git@github.com:redwood/redwood-cli.git (fetch)` and `(push)`. i was trying to push to upstream because the branch is intended for a draft PR. my GH username is mira-oss and my local commits show `mira@personal.email`.

lina: quick check: does the repo have a protected-branch policy that blocks direct pushes? most of our repos block pushes to main but allow pushes to feature branches. 403 on push usually means your GH user doesn't have repo write perms. are you a member of the 'cli' team?

mira: i see the 'cli' team in the Teams tab but it's marked as "pending membership" next to my account.

ops-jordan: that means the org invite might have created a shadow account or the invite was to a different email. can you go to https://github.com/settings/emails and confirm which email is primary? also, if you added an SSH key to a different GH account it can authenticate but not map to team membership.

mira: primary email is mira+dev@gmail.com. work email mira@redwood.com is listed but not primary. i think the invite went to mira@redwood.com. my laptop ssh key is on the mira-oss account (mira+dev@gmail.com).

tao: to resolve: either move your ssh key to the work account, add your work email as primary, or we can re-invite the account that owns the key. ops-jordan can also set up a fork+PR workflow for you in the meantime (push to your fork then open PR).

mira: also, i registered my YubiKey on my personal GH profile last year. do i need to register it again on the work account? worried about losing access.

ops-jordan: security policy: we prefer dedicated MFA on org accounts. please register a separate 2FA method on the work account (or a second YubiKey). do not transfer a company key to your personal account. ops can expedite a replacement key if needed.

lina: temporary workaround: push the branch to your fork (`git remote add fork git@github.com:mira-oss/redwood-cli.git && git push fork mira/feat/cli`) and open a PR. we'll sort out team membership with identity next.

mira: thanks. pushed to my fork and created draft PR #12. i also sent a DM to ops-jordan with my GH username and which email the invite went to.

ops-jordan: got it; i updated the invite to the mira-oss account and set SSO. you should get a new invite email. once accepted i'll sync team membership.

mira: accepted the new invite, can now push to upstream branch and add reviewers. cheers! :party_parrot:
